caption:
Bhari ply uthane se pareshan hain? Dekhiye iska asaan solution PP shuttering sheet ke saath.

Yeh halki sheet ek aadmi akele utha sakta hai. Sahi handling ke saath ply se 2-3 guna zyada chalti hai aur waterproof hai.

Apne thekedar aur mistri dosto ko zaroor bhejo.
